summary:
NIYOJAN Phase 7: Final Production Deployment, End-to-End Validation & Launch Readiness Report.
Documents the complete repository audit, multi-stage Docker containerization, Cloud Run deployment configuration, Firebase security rules deployment, and execution of all 20 end-to-end recruitment workflows (with 20/20 scenarios and 23/23 Vitest tests passing). Concludes with an enterprise performance assessment, environment architecture documentation, and the final production declaration.
